en.title: ECB keeps key interest rate at 2.5%
en.dek: ECB held its main policy rate at 2.5% on 29 Oct 2026 and President Christine Lagarde announced she will resign on 7 Feb 2027.
facts: ECB kept its main policy rate at 2.5% on 29 Oct 2026 (Tagesschau, CNBC).
The decision was reported by Yahoo Finance and CNA as made on Thursday (Yahoo Finance, CNA).
President Christine Lagarde will resign effective 7 Feb 2027 (Euronews, The Straits Times).
Lagarde said the ECB debated a rate hike and a December move is now in focus (Euronews, Morningstar).
ECB cited an energy shock as an inflation driver (Morningstar).
body: On 29 October 2026, the European Central Bank left its main policy rate unchanged at 2.5%, according to Tagesschau and CNBC. Yahoo Finance and CNA noted that the decision was made on Thursday.

President Christine Lagarde announced she will step down on 7 February 2027, saying she wants to speak freely on topics beyond monetary policy. The announcement was reported by Euronews, The Straits Times and CNBC.
Lagarde said the Governing Council debated a rate hike and that a possible move in December is now in focus. Morningstar reported that the December hike moves into focus following the meeting.
The ECB cited an energy shock as a driver of inflation when it left rates unchanged. Morningstar highlighted the energy shock in its coverage of the decision.
The euro edged higher against the dollar after the decision, as reported by CNA. Yahoo Finance also noted that European equities rose in Thursday trading following the announcement.
Speculation about Lagarde’s future had been reported for months, and The Straits Times said her resignation comes after that period of speculation. The resignation is effective 7 February 2027.
en.context: The ECB cited an energy shock as a driver of inflation when it left rates unchanged (Morningstar).

de.title: EZB belässt Leitzins bei 2,5 %
de.dek: Die EZB hielt ihren Leitzins am 29. Oktober 2026 bei 2,5 %, und Präsidentin Christine Lagarde kündigte ihren Rücktritt zum 7. Februar 2027 an.
facts: Die EZB beließ ihren Leitzins am 29. Oktober 2026 bei 2,5 % (Tagesschau, CNBC).
Die Entscheidung wurde von Yahoo Finance und CNA als am Donnerstag getroffen gemeldet (Yahoo Finance, CNA).
Präsidentin Christine Lagarde wird zum 7. Februar 2027 zurücktreten (Euronews, The Straits Times).
Lagarde sagte, die EZB habe über eine Zinserhöhung debattiert und ein Schritt im Dezember stehe nun im Fokus (Euronews, Morningstar).
Die EZB nannte einen Energieschock als Inflationstreiber (Morningstar).
body: Am 29. Oktober 2026 beließ die Europäische Zentralbank ihren Leitzins unverändert bei 2,5 %, so Tagesschau und CNBC. Yahoo Finance und CNA merkten an, dass die Entscheidung am Donnerstag getroffen wurde.

Präsidentin Christine Lagarde kündigte an, dass sie am 7. Februar 2027 zurücktreten wird, mit der Begründung, sie wolle sich frei zu Themen außerhalb der Geldpolitik äußern. Die Ankündigung wurde von Euronews, The Straits Times und CNBC berichtet.

Lagarde sagte, der Rat habe über eine Zinserhöhung debattiert und ein möglicher Schritt im Dezember stehe nun im Fokus. Morningstar berichtete, dass die Dezember-Erhöhung nach dem Treffen in den Fokus rücke.
Die EZB nannte einen Energieschock als Treiber der Inflation, als sie die Zinsen unverändert ließ. Morningstar hob den Energieschock in seiner Berichterstattung über die Entscheidung hervor.
Der Euro legte nach der Entscheidung gegenüber dem Dollar leicht zu, wie CNA berichtete. Yahoo Finance merkte ebenfalls an, dass europäische Aktien im Donnerstagshandel nach der Ankündigung stiegen.

Spekulationen über Lagardes Zukunft wurden bereits seit Monaten berichtet, und The Straits Times schrieb, ihr Rücktritt erfolge nach dieser Phase der Spekulation. Der Rücktritt wird zum 7. Februar 2027 wirksam.
de.context: Die EZB nannte einen Energieschock als Treiber der Inflation, als sie die Zinsen unverändert ließ (Morningstar).

fr.title: La BCE maintient son principal taux d'intérêt à 2,5 %
fr.dek: La BCE a maintenu son principal taux directeur à 2,5 % le 29 octobre 2026, et sa présidente, Christine Lagarde, a annoncé sa démission pour le 7 février 2027.
facts: La BCE a maintenu son principal taux directeur à 2,5 % le 29 octobre 2026 (Tagesschau, CNBC).
Yahoo Finance et CNA ont rapporté que cette décision a été prise jeudi (Yahoo Finance, CNA).
La présidente Christine Lagarde démissionnera avec effet au 7 février 2027 (Euronews, The Straits Times).
Mme Lagarde a indiqué que la BCE avait débattu d'une hausse des taux et qu'une mesure en décembre est désormais envisagée (Euronews, Morningstar).
La BCE a cité un choc énergétique comme facteur d'inflation (Morningstar).
body: Le 29 octobre 2026, la Banque centrale européenne a laissé son principal taux directeur inchangé à 2,5 %, selon Tagesschau et CNBC. Yahoo Finance et CNA ont précisé que la décision a été prise jeudi.

La présidente Christine Lagarde a annoncé qu'elle quitterait ses fonctions le 7 février 2027, affirmant vouloir s'exprimer librement sur des sujets dépassant le cadre de la politique monétaire. L'annonce a été relayée par Euronews, The Straits Times et CNBC.

Mme Lagarde a déclaré que le Conseil des gouverneurs avait débattu d'une hausse des taux et qu'une éventuelle mesure en décembre est désormais à l'étude. Morningstar a rapporté que l'échéance de décembre est devenue prioritaire à l'issue de la réunion.
En maintenant ses taux, la BCE a désigné un choc énergétique comme moteur de l'inflation. Morningstar a souligné l'impact de ce choc énergétique dans son analyse de la décision.
L'euro a légèrement progressé face au dollar après l'annonce, selon CNA. Yahoo Finance a également noté une hausse des actions européennes lors de la séance de jeudi.

Des spéculations sur l'avenir de Mme Lagarde circulaient depuis plusieurs mois, et The Straits Times a indiqué que sa démission intervenait après cette période d'incertitude. Son départ sera effectif le 7 février 2027.
fr.context: La BCE a cité un choc énergétique comme facteur d'inflation lors du maintien de ses taux (Morningstar).

es.title: El BCE mantiene el tipo de interés clave en el 2,5 %
es.dek: El BCE mantuvo su tasa de política monetaria principal en el 2,5 % el 29 de octubre de 2026, y la presidenta Christine Lagarde anunció que dimitirá el 7 de febrero de 2027.
facts: El BCE mantuvo su tasa de política monetaria principal en el 2,5 % el 29 de octubre de 2026 (Tagesschau, CNBC).
Yahoo Finance y CNA informaron que la decisión se tomó el jueves (Yahoo Finance, CNA).
La presidenta Christine Lagarde dimitirá con efecto el 7 de febrero de 2027 (Euronews, The Straits Times).
Lagarde afirmó que el BCE debatió una subida de tipos y que ahora el foco está puesto en una posible medida en diciembre (Euronews, Morningstar).
El BCE señaló un choque energético como motor de la inflación (Morningstar).
body: El 29 de octubre de 2026, el Banco Central Europeo mantuvo sin cambios su tasa de política monetaria principal en el 2,5 %, según Tagesschau y CNBC. Yahoo Finance y CNA señalaron que la decisión se tomó el jueves.

La presidenta Christine Lagarde anunció que dejará su cargo el 7 de febrero de 2027, manifestando su deseo de hablar libremente sobre temas ajenos a la política monetaria. El anuncio fue reportado por Euronews, The Straits Times y CNBC.

Lagarde afirmó que el Consejo de Gobierno debatió una subida de tipos y que ahora se centra la atención en un posible movimiento en diciembre. Morningstar informó que, tras la reunión, la subida de diciembre pasa a ser el punto focal.
Al mantener los tipos sin cambios, el BCE señaló un choque energético como uno de los factores que impulsan la inflación. Morningstar destacó este choque energético en su cobertura de la decisión.
El euro subió ligeramente frente al dólar tras la decisión, según informó CNA. Yahoo Finance también señaló que las acciones europeas subieron en la sesión del jueves tras el anuncio.

Las especulaciones sobre el futuro de Lagarde se habían reportado durante meses, y The Straits Times afirmó que su dimisión llega tras ese periodo de incertidumbre. La renuncia será efectiva el 7 de febrero de 2027.
es.context: El BCE señaló un choque energético como motor de la inflación al mantener los tipos sin cambios (Morningstar).

it.title: BCE mantiene il tasso di interesse chiave al 2,5%
it.dek: La BCE ha mantenuto invariato il tasso di riferimento al 2,5% il 29 ottobre 2026; la presidente Christine Lagarde ha annunciato le proprie dimissioni per il 7 febbraio 2027.
facts: La BCE ha mantenuto il tasso di riferimento al 2,5% il 29 ottobre 2026 (Tagesschau, CNBC).
Yahoo Finance e CNA hanno riportato che la decisione è stata presa giovedì (Yahoo Finance, CNA).
La presidente Christine Lagarde si dimetterà con effetto dal 7 febbraio 2027 (Euronews, The Straits Times).
Lagarde ha dichiarato che la BCE ha discusso un rialzo dei tassi e che l'attenzione è ora rivolta a un possibile intervento a dicembre (Euronews, Morningstar).
La BCE ha indicato uno shock energetico come fattore trainante dell'inflazione (Morningstar).
body: Il 29 ottobre 2026, la Banca Centrale Europea ha lasciato invariato il tasso di riferimento al 2,5%, secondo quanto riportato da Tagesschau e CNBC. Yahoo Finance e CNA hanno precisato che la decisione è stata presa giovedì.

La presidente Christine Lagarde ha annunciato che lascerà l'incarico il 7 febbraio 2027, dichiarando di voler parlare liberamente di temi che vadano oltre la politica monetaria. L'annuncio è stato riportato da Euronews, The Straits Times e CNBC.

Lagarde ha affermato che il Consiglio direttivo ha discusso un rialzo dei tassi e che l'attenzione è ora focalizzata su un possibile intervento a dicembre. Morningstar ha riportato che l'ipotesi di un rialzo a dicembre è emersa a seguito della riunione.
Nel mantenere invariati i tassi, la BCE ha citato uno shock energetico come causa dell'inflazione. Morningstar ha sottolineato l'impatto della crisi energetica nel proprio resoconto della decisione.

Dopo la decisione, l'euro ha registrato un lieve rialzo rispetto al dollaro, come riportato da CNA. Yahoo Finance ha inoltre osservato che i titoli azionari europei sono saliti durante la sessione di giovedì a seguito dell'annuncio.

Le speculazioni sul futuro di Lagarde circolavano da mesi e, secondo The Straits Times, le sue dimissioni arrivano dopo questo periodo di incertezza. Le dimissioni saranno effettive dal 7 febbraio 2027.
it.context: La BCE ha citato uno shock energetico come fattore trainante dell'inflazione nel mantenere invariati i tassi (Morningstar).

pt.title: BCE mantém taxa de juro principal em 2,5%
pt.dek: O BCE manteve a sua taxa de juro principal em 2,5% a 29 de outubro de 2026, e a presidente Christine Lagarde anunciou que irá demitir-se a 7 de fevereiro de 2027.
facts: O BCE manteve a sua taxa de juro principal em 2,5% a 29 de outubro de 2026 (Tagesschau, CNBC).
A decisão foi reportada pelo Yahoo Finance e pela CNA como tendo sido tomada na quinta-feira (Yahoo Finance, CNA).
A presidente Christine Lagarde irá demitir-se com efeitos a 7 de fevereiro de 2027 (Euronews, The Straits Times).
Lagarde afirmou que o BCE debateu um aumento das taxas e que um eventual ajuste em dezembro está agora sob análise (Euronews, Morningstar).
O BCE apontou um choque energético como fator impulsionador da inflação (Morningstar).
body: A 29 de outubro de 2026, o Banco Central Europeu manteve inalterada a sua taxa de juro principal em 2,5%, segundo a Tagesschau e a CNBC. O Yahoo Finance e a CNA notaram que a decisão foi tomada na quinta-feira.

A presidente Christine Lagarde anunciou que deixará o cargo a 7 de fevereiro de 2027, afirmando que pretende falar livremente sobre temas que transcendam a política monetária. O anúncio foi reportado pela Euronews, The Straits Times e CNBC.

Lagarde afirmou que o Conselho do Governador debateu um aumento das taxas e que um possível ajuste em dezembro está agora sob análise. A Morningstar reportou que a subida em dezembro passou a ser o foco após a reunião.
Ao manter as taxas inalteradas, o BCE apontou um choque energético como um dos motores da inflação. A Morningstar destacou o choque energético na sua cobertura da decisão.
O euro registou uma ligeira subida face ao dólar após a decisão, segundo a CNA. O Yahoo Finance notou igualmente que as ações europeias subiram nas negociações de quinta-feira após o anúncio.

As especulações sobre o futuro de Lagarde tinham sido reportadas durante meses, e o The Straits Times afirmou que a sua demissão surge após esse período de incerteza. A demissão entra em vigor a 7 de fevereiro de 2027.
pt.context: O BCE apontou um choque energético como um dos motores da inflação ao manter as taxas inalteradas (Morningstar).

zh.title: 欧洲央行维持关键利率在2.5%不变
zh.dek: 欧洲央行于2026年10月29日将主要政策利率维持在2.5%，行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德宣布将于2027年2月7日辞职。
facts: 欧洲央行于2026年10月29日将主要政策利率维持在2.5%（Tagesschau, CNBC）。
雅虎财经（Yahoo Finance）和亚洲新闻台（CNA）报道称，该决定于周四做出（Yahoo Finance, CNA）。
行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德将于2027年2月7日正式辞职（Euronews, The Straits Times）。
拉加德表示，欧洲央行讨论了加息问题，目前的关注焦点是12月的行动（Euronews, Morningstar）。
欧洲央行将能源冲击列为通胀驱动因素（Morningstar）。
body: 据Tagesschau和CNBC报道，欧洲中央银行于2026年10月29日将主要政策利率维持在2.5%不变。雅虎财经和亚洲新闻台指出，该决定于周四做出。
行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德宣布将于2027年2月7日卸任，并表示希望在货币政策之外的领域畅所欲言。Euronews、《海峡时报》和CNBC均报道了这一消息。
拉加德表示，管理委员会讨论了加息问题，目前关注焦点转向12月可能采取的行动。Morningstar报道称，此次会议后，12月加息成为关注重点。
欧洲央行在维持利率不变的同时，将能源冲击列为通胀的驱动因素。Morningstar在报道该决定时重点强调了能源冲击的影响。
据亚洲新闻台报道，该决定公布后，欧元兑美元汇率小幅上涨。雅虎财经还指出，欧洲股市在周四交易中随之上涨。
关于拉加德未来去向的猜测已持续数月，《海峡时报》称其辞职是在这段猜测期之后做出的。辞职将于2027年2月7日生效。
zh.context: 欧洲央行在维持利率不变的同时，将能源冲击列为通胀的驱动因素（Morningstar）。

ja.title: 欧州中央銀行、主要政策金利を2.5%に据え置き
ja.dek: 欧州中央銀行（ECB）は2026年10月29日、主要政策金利を2.5%に維持した。あわせてクリスティーヌ・ラガルド総裁が2027年2月7日付で辞任することを発表した。
facts: ECBは2026年10月29日、主要政策金利を2.5%に据え置いた（Tagesschau、CNBC）。
Yahoo FinanceおよびCNAは、この決定が木曜日になされたと報じた（Yahoo Finance、CNA）。
クリスティーヌ・ラガルド総裁が2027年2月7日付で辞任する（Euronews、The Straits Times）。
ラガルド総裁は、ECB内で利上げが議論され、現在は12月の動向に注目が集まっていると述べた（Euronews、Morningstar）。
ECBはインフレの要因としてエネルギーショックを挙げた（Morningstar）。
body: TagesschauおよびCNBCによると、欧州中央銀行（ECB）は2026年10月29日、主要政策金利を2.5%で据え置いた。Yahoo FinanceとCNAは、この決定が木曜日になされたと伝えている。
クリスティーヌ・ラガルド総裁は、金融政策以外のテーマについて自由に発言したいとして、2027年2月7日付で辞任することを発表した。この発表はEuronews、The Straits Times、CNBCが報じた。
ラガルド総裁は、管理理事会で利上げが議論され、12月に措置を講じる可能性に注目が集まっていると述べた。Morningstarは、今回の会合を経て12月の利上げが焦点となったと報じている。
ECBは金利を据え置いた際、インフレの要因としてエネルギーショックを挙げた。Morningstarは、今回の決定に関する報道の中でエネルギーショックに言及した。
CNAによると、この決定を受けてユーロはドルに対してわずかに上昇した。またYahoo Financeは、発表後の木曜日の取引で欧州株が上昇したと伝えている。
ラガルド総裁の去就を巡る憶測は数ヶ月前から報じられており、The Straits Timesは、こうした憶測が続いた末に辞任に至ったとしている。辞任日は2027年2月7日の予定だ。
ja.context: ECBは金利を据え置いた際、インフレの要因としてエネルギーショックを挙げた（Morningstar）。

ko.title: 유럽중앙은행, 기준금리 2.5% 동결
ko.dek: 유럽중앙은행(ECB)이 2026년 10월 29일 기준금리를 2.5%로 동결한 가운데, 크리스틴 라가르드 총재가 2027년 2월 7일자로 사임하겠다고 발표했다.
facts: ECB는 2026년 10월 29일 기준금리를 2.5%로 유지했다 (Tagesschau, CNBC).
야후 파이낸스와 CNA는 이번 결정이 목요일에 내려졌다고 보도했다 (Yahoo Finance, CNA).
크리스틴 라가르드 총재는 2027년 2월 7일부로 사임할 예정이다 (Euronews, The Straits Times).
라가르드 총재는 ECB가 금리 인상을 논의했으며, 현재 12월 조정 가능성에 주목하고 있다고 밝혔다 (Euronews, Morningstar).
ECB는 인플레이션의 원인으로 에너지 쇼크를 꼽았다 (Morningstar).
body: 타게스샤우와 CNBC에 따르면, 유럽중앙은행(ECB)은 2026년 10월 29일 기준금리를 2.5%로 동결했다. 야후 파이낸스와 CNA는 이번 결정이 목요일에 내려졌다고 전했다.
크리스틴 라가르드 총재는 통화 정책 이외의 주제에 대해 자유롭게 의견을 나누고 싶다며 2027년 2월 7일자로 물러나겠다고 발표했다. 이 소식은 유로뉴스, 스트레이츠 타임스, CNBC를 통해 보도되었다.
라가르드 총재는 정책위원회에서 금리 인상을 논의했으며, 이제 12월의 금리 조정 가능성에 초점이 맞춰졌다고 밝혔다. 모닝스타는 이번 회의 이후 12월 인상 여부가 핵심 쟁점이 되었다고 보도했다.
ECB는 금리를 동결하면서 에너지 쇼크를 인플레이션의 주요 동인으로 언급했다. 모닝스타는 이번 결정 보도에서 에너지 쇼크 부분을 강조했다.
CNA는 이번 결정 이후 유로화 가치가 달러 대비 소폭 상승했다고 보도했다. 야후 파이낸스 또한 발표 이후 목요일 거래에서 유럽 증시가 상승했다고 전했다.
라가르드 총재의 거취에 대한 추측은 수개월 전부터 제기되어 왔으며, 스트레이츠 타임스는 이러한 추측 끝에 사임 결정이 내려졌다고 보도했다. 사임 효력은 2027년 2월 7일부터 발생한다.
ko.context: ECB는 금리를 동결하며 에너지 쇼크를 인플레이션의 원인으로 꼽았다 (Morningstar).

en.dek: ECB keeps main policy rate at 2.5% and announces President Christine Lagarde will resign on 7 February 2027.
body: On 29 October 2026, the ECB left its main policy rate unchanged at 2.5% and announced that President Christine Lagarde will step down on 7 February 2027. According to Yahoo Finance and CNA, the decision was made on Thursday.
The rate decision was reported by Tagesschau and CNBC, which both said the ECB held the rate at 2.5%.
Lagarde said the ECB debated a rate hike and hinted at a possible move in December. Euronews reported that she made the statement, and Morningstar noted that the December hike is now in focus.
Lagarde confirmed her resignation in a statement released by The Straits Times and CNBC. She said she would step down before the end of her term to speak freely on topics beyond monetary policy.
The ECB cited an energy shock as a driver of inflation when it left rates unchanged. Morningstar reported that the energy shock is an inflation driver.
The decision comes after months of speculation about Lagarde’s future. The Straits Times reported that her resignation is effective 7 February 2027.
The ECB’s policy rate influences borrowing costs across eurozone member states.
Lagarde has served as ECB president since 2019.
facts: Christine Lagarde will resign on 7 February 2027.
ECB kept its main policy rate at 2.5%.
ECB debated a rate hike and hinted at a December move.
An energy shock is cited as an inflation driver.
Decision was made on 29 October 2026.
en.title: ECB keeps key interest rate at 2.5%
en.context: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the eurozone, with its main policy rate influencing borrowing costs across member states. Christine Lagarde has served as ECB president since 2019. The ECB’s policy decisions are closely watched by markets and governments.

en.dek: ECB held its main policy rate at 2.5% and announced President Christine Lagarde will resign on 7 February 2027.
body: The European Central Bank held its main policy rate at 2.5% and announced President Christine Lagarde will resign on 7 February 2027. According to Tagesschau and CNBC, the rate was unchanged. According to Euronews and The Straits Times, Lagarde will step down before the end of her term.
Lagarde said the ECB debated a hike and hinted at a December move. According to Euronews, she mentioned the debate. According to Morningstar, the December hike moves into focus.
The decision was reported on 29 October 2026. Tagesschau and CNBC published the reports that day. Euronews also reported the resignation on the same date.
Lagarde said she will step down to speak freely on topics beyond monetary policy. According to The Straits Times, she cited a desire to discuss broader issues. CNBC reported the same.

The ECB's decision to keep rates unchanged follows concerns about energy shock driving inflation. According to Morningstar, the energy shock is cited as an inflation driver. The ECB maintained the rate at 2.5%.
The resignation comes months before Lagarde's mandate ends. According to Euronews, she will step down in February 2027. The Straits Times reported the resignation effective 7 February 2027.

en.context: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the eurozone, with its main policy rate influencing borrowing costs across member states. Christine Lagarde has served as ECB president since 2019. The ECB's policy decisions are closely watched by markets and governments.

en.dek: The European Central Bank held its main policy rate at 2.5% and announced President Christine Lagarde will step down on Feb. 7, 2027.
